segments.text: I have endometriosis and for [music] the last 7 years I've been dealing with those symptoms before I got my official diagnosis. [music] I remember very distinctly years ago being on vacation in Hawaii and having excruciating [music] pain while trying to use the restroom.

And I almost felt like I was going to pass out. It was that painful. I worried, is this something I need to [music] go to the emergency room for? And sadly this is an experience that is not uncommon and a lot of other women have pain while having sex or obviously excruciating pain during that period.

[music] So what's actually happening is that endo tissue is growing outside the places it should. And so this can grow all over your body. It can grow even in your lungs and it causes havoc. It [music] scars, it fuses organs together. And so one of the things we're doing is we're taking my endometriosis [music] tissue, we're growing it in essentially a petri dish, we're building an organoid, a living organoid of my endo tissue and then we'll try and treat it outside my body and see what responds and what doesn't respond before doing that in my body. So this will be using drugs without surgery. We're going to try and do this in 8 months and be at

the absolute frontier of science trying to do [music] things that are experimental that maybe we'll be able to develop a protocol for also treating endometriosis without surgery. So follow along and we'll share everything with you for free online cuz this is absolutely my passion is to help females out there get [music] a better life quality for themselves including in their health.
